name: xmlDelete
description: Deletes every child element with a given name from an XML node and returns the node.

params.name: xmlNode
params.description: The XML document or element to delete from. Adobe's docs call this `xmlObject`, but CF2025 only accepts `xmlNode` as a named argument.

params.name: key
params.description: Name of the child elements to delete. Adobe's docs call this `childName`, but CF2025 only accepts `key` as a named argument.

examples.title: Delete child elements
examples.description: Both `a` elements are removed, leaving only `b`.
